name: Deliah's Ring
summary: A grim trail begins with Deliah's Ring, found among the Rot Hide gnolls’ corpse piles in Silverpine Forest. Its inscription, “For Deliah,” points back to a plague victim taken from Tirisfal’s mass graves.

sections.title: A Keepsake in the Mire
sections.body: Among the gnoll mounds in Silverpine Forest, a ring rests on the pockmarked hand of a relatively fresh corpse. The band bears a simple inscription: “For Deliah.” The Rot Hide gnolls are doing more than scavenging battlefields. They raid the mass graves of Tirisfal Glades and carry human and Forsaken corpses south to Fenris Isle for their own purposes.

sections.title: Ties to Brill
sections.body: High Executor Hadrec sends the ring to Brill, where Magistrate Sevren keeps records of the recently deceased. Sevren confirms that Deliah lived in Brill and died of the plague. She was buried before body-snatchers exhumed her remains. The ring leads to the grief of those she left behind, and to the question of whether mortal devotion can endure undeath.

aliases: how do you get deliahs ring
faq.answer: The ring is found among the Rot Hide gnoll mounds in northern Silverpine Forest, on the hand of an unwrapped plague victim among the scavenged dead.
Deliah lived in Brill and died of the plague. She was buried in the local mass graves before Rot Hide gnolls stole her body and dragged it into Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Why did the Rot Hide gnolls have her body?
aliases: what are gnolls doing with corpses
faq.answer: The Rot Hide gnolls, aligned with the Scourge, pillage the communal graves in Tirisfal Glades. They stockpile corpses and carry them toward their stronghold on Fenris Isle.

faq.q: What is the inscription on the ring?
faq.answer: The ring bears the words “For Deliah” inside its band. It was a personal gift from a lover or husband before her death.

angles.text: As an undead, you know that mortal attachments can fade alongside the flesh. A rare few still hold to the memory of those they loved in life.
